description: Form composition layer built on React Hook Form and Radix UI LabelPrimitive. Provides Form, FormField, FormItem, FormControl, FormLabel, FormDescription, and FormMessage components that wire validation state, accessibility attributes, and error messaging automatically.
useCases: Survey creation and settings forms with field-level validation
User profile and account settings forms with Zod schema validation
Login, registration, and password reset flows
Multi-field configuration panels with inline error feedback
